    rows = int(panel["rows"])

    horizontal = (column_index - float(panel["beam_column"])) * pixel_size

    distance = np.full_like(horizontal, float(panel["sample_to_panel_m"]))
    return horizontal, vertical, distance


def _signal(panel: dict[str, Any], signal: dict[str, Any]) -> np.ndarray:
    row_index, column_index = np.indices((int(panel["rows"]), int(panel["columns"])), dtype=np.float64)
    intensity = np.full(row_index.shape, float(signal["background"]), dtype=np.float64)
    for feature in signal["features"]:
